purpose: Approved landscape and woven homepage artwork
encoding: WebP quality 86, phone variants at 800px and quality 84. No compositional edits.

prompts.prompt: Generate a refined original website hero BACKGROUND ART asset for Atrax, a practical cloud for small businesses building software with their own coding agents. This is an art-direction exploration, not a website mockup. Wide panoramic 16:9 image, ideally 2560x1440. Art direction: an architectural landscape screenprint, warm and capable. A connected landscape of low simple terracotta workshops/pavilions, gently terraced ochre earth, sparse dark olive shrubs and very fine charcoal paths connecting places. Crafted flat gouache and clean woodcut-like drawing, restrained subtle paper grain, confident large silhouettes with tiny beautiful construction details. A mature contemporary illustrator's commissioned brand image, not children's storybook, not fantasy concept art, not 3D render. Palette warm ivory paper #f6f3ec, burnt orange/copper #d56b35, muted ochre, olive gray and dark charcoal. Composition purpose: HTML headline and a terminal will be centered above this background. Keep the central 60 percent of width and upper 70 percent of height almost empty warm ivory with only the subtlest paper texture; no forms there. Artwork gathers in the LOWER quarter and the outer left and right edges, with one tiny pavilion off-center low right and a lower terraced landform at bottom left. The very bottom should gently dissolve into the exact same warm ivory paper without a hard edge, so the next webpage section can continue. Large negative space is essential, avoid a large central object. No sky gradient, no clouds, no glowing nodes, no floating blobs, no cute mascot, no ducks, no trees framing the entire top, no shadows imitating UI. NO text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark, UI, buttons, screenshots or border. Image only. The effect should be quiet, tactile, memorable, and clean enough for a professional software company's home page.

Generate an original high-end abstract website hero BACKGROUND ART for Atrax, a cloud connecting a small business's apps, data and people. Art-direction exploration, not a webpage mockup. Wide 16:9 panoramic image, ideally 2560x1440. A macro editorial photograph of a bespoke sculptural woven textile made of many fine matte natural linen threads. Flat translucent ribbons of densely parallel copper orange and charcoal olive threads enter from the far left and lower right, interlace once along the BOTTOM EDGE into a neat open weave, then sweep out of frame. Physical fiber detail, exact controlled geometry, believable soft raking daylight, faint cast shadows against warm ivory uncoated paper. It feels engineered and tactile, not an AI network diagram. Keep most of the image luminous warm ivory paper #f6f3ec. The central 65 percent of width and top 75 percent of height is CLEAR negative space reserved for HTML heading and terminal. The thread construction lives almost entirely in the outer margins and lower quarter. A disciplined palette: ivory, natural flax, burnt copper orange #d56b35, a little desaturated dark olive charcoal. No saturated blue, no purple, no pink, no bright green, no glowing neon, no gradients, no chrome, no glass, no shiny 3D blobs, no knots, no tangled cables. No text, letters, logos, symbols, interface, buttons, computers, UI cards or watermark. Subtle, coherent, professional commissioned brand artwork with one compelling physical idea. Allow clean warm paper at the bottommost boundary for webpage blending.

Create a NEW original brand illustration for the Apps and Database section of the Atrax website. The provided image is a MATERIAL AND PALETTE REFERENCE only. Keep its finely detailed linen fibers, matte copper-orange, natural flax and dark olive, raking soft daylight and warm ivory uncoated paper. Different composition: one beautifully constructed rectangular app-shaped FRAME woven from copper linen strands rises at a slight perspective angle above THREE thin square planes of densely woven ivory linen stacked with precise gaps. The frame has an entirely empty ivory opening, no UI or writing. A few taut orderly dark olive threads connect the frame down to the woven layers, suggesting one app with its own persistent database. It must feel like an artist's small physical engineering model photographed close up, handmade but precise. Sophisticated geometric fiber sculpture, crisp edges, no shiny 3D rendering, no cute icons, no computers, no servers, no boxes floating randomly, no tangled threads. Wide 3:2 image, main sculptural object centered and occupying 65 percent of frame, generous breathing room at every edge, background uniform warm ivory #f6f3ec with subtle paper detail. All objects fully visible. No letters, numbers, text, labels, UI, logos, watermark, border or infographic. This is a beautiful product metaphor, not an actual software screenshot. It will sit beside concise HTML copy on a professional website.

Create a NEW original website brand-art background for Atrax Access. Use the provided image as a REFERENCE for natural linen fibers, copper-orange, flax and dark olive, tactile craftsmanship and soft physical lighting. New composition: a SINGLE exact circular loop made from several neatly woven copper and natural-flax bands, like a carefully engineered boundary, lying flat on a very dark olive matte paper surface approximate #292d25. Wide 2:1 composition. The circular loop is centered precisely at the middle, outer diameter about 66 percent of image HEIGHT. Its inside is clear empty dark olive paper. A single copper strand leaves the ring gently toward the far right edge; an olive/flax bundle approaches from the left, tidy and controlled. Threads never look tangled. The ring is a visual metaphor for a workspace boundary, not a lock or security seal. Natural textile macro photography with gorgeous tiny fiber detail, soft short shadows, quiet dimensionality, editorial quality. Keep the outer 20 percent left and right mostly empty dark olive, and top/bottom clear enough for HTML. Dark field is consistent to all four edges, no gradient glows, no blue, no purple, no black void, no neon, no gold luxury style, no hard frame, no 3D plastic, no shield, no padlock. No text, no letters, no symbols, no logos, no watermark, no UI. Strong contrast between flax/orange fibers and dark olive paper. Designed to make one distinct dark chapter in an otherwise warm-paper software landing page.

Generate a NEW original brand illustration for Atrax Library, the shared company knowledge capability. Provided image is STYLE AND MATERIAL REFERENCE only: preserve fine natural linen fibers, warm ivory uncoated paper, matte copper orange, dark olive accents, soft raking daylight, and an engineered handcrafted feel. New composition: a close-up still life of an OPEN simple linen-bound folio or archive folder seen from elevated three-quarter view, with a restrained fan of THREE warm ivory paper leaves turning outward. Several precise thin copper-orange threads stitch the spine and extend neatly from the bottom edge, connecting the pages as one collection. One page edge has a narrow olive cloth tab. Every page is blank, no text and no ruled lines. Paper looks tactile and real with tiny fibers, the linen spine is carefully woven, not fuzzy. Confident large sculptural silhouette on uniform warm ivory #f6f3ec paper ground. Wide 3:2 image, the folio fills 65 percent of image width, centered, all edges visible with generous breathing room. This is commissioned brand imagery for a professional practical software company, not stationery ecommerce, vintage manuscript or scrapbook. No flowers, pencils, stamps, wax seals, quills, hands, bookshelves, extra accessories or floating cards. No UI, letters, numerals, logos, border or watermark. Keep the same copper/olive/flax family as the reference while making a completely different and immediately understandable object.
